rules.title: 2026 Annual General Adjustment
rules.requirement: [Basis: official explanatory text, not operative legal text] Eligible landlords may increase 2025 permanent rent ceilings by up to 1.0% no earlier than January 1, 2026.
rules.exemptions: The 2026 AGA may not adjust rent for tenants whose tenancy began on or after January 1, 2025, and whose rent was set pursuant to the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act. [Rent Board Regulation 1148]
rules.quoted_span:
At its regular meeting on October 16, 2025, the Berkeley Rent Stabilization Board 
adopted the Annual General Adjustment (AGA) Order for Year 2026 which will allow 
eligible landlords to increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than 
January 1, 2026.
